generators.model: Blender (bpy Python module) — procedural characters, no external models, textures, or HDRIs
generators.version: bpy 5.2.2 LTS (PyPI wheel), Cycles CPU + OpenImageDenoise
generators.license: Project-original: every mesh, material, and light is generated by the committed scripts; Blender is GPL-licensed software and its output carries no license obligation
generators.commercialUse: Allowed; no third-party asset, reference pack, logo, trademark, or character is used
generators.notes: Six protagonist outfits x six poses x two facings and six Companion forms x six states, built from primitives on a joint rig, with the PS-244 toon materials and Freestyle outlines and an orthographic camera along the canonical room camera direction.

processors.purpose: Full-canvas renders with a transparent film: 512 x 512 protagonists (ground point at 241/256), 256 x 256 Companions (centred)
Edge-clipping check, protagonist contact shadow, lossy WebP (quality 90, lossless alpha), outputs.json hashes, contact sheets and a room preview

camera.notes: Orthographic sprite cameras along the canonical room camera direction (scene.CAMERA), so the characters share the room's viewing angle.
